pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit opening multiple entries within a 3-minute window (no concurrent micro-stacking into potential wicks); subsequent scale-ins require a minimum 3.0 point verified trend displacement.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order block and volume delta confirmation filter: deny all entries if the 1-minute ATR exceeds 2.5x the 20-period moving average.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger partial scaling or aggressive breakeven locking the moment floating profit hits +$4.00 to prevent evaporation, allowing the remainder to run to +$15.00-$30.00.
